page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmg8a.48xlarge is an x86_64 architecture bare-metal instance powered by AMD EPYC 9T24 processors running at a baseline frequency of 2.7 GHz. The instance features 192 dedicated vCPUs and 768.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It operates on a KVM hypervisor.

This instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through network-attached block storage. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps to handle high-throughput network traffic. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are included, and there are no hardware GPU accelerators bundled with this instance.

The ecs.ebmg8a.48xlarge offers high resource density for workloads requiring massive parallel processing without the need for local storage or GPU acceleration. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent performance for enterprise-grade applications. It is suitable for large-scale general-purpose workloads, high-concurrency web serving, distributed enterprise applications, and memory-balanced batch processing.
